|game_text=Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition <3 (<5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Anakin Solo]]; it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints it; the release-sheet slip shows the original text (see [[Anakin Solo]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Anakin Solo]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095520/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once per turn, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Anakin_Solo.png]]) prints it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 3) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “Once per turn” to “Once during battle” and printed “<3 (<5”<ref name="cl-1282_12-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012)</ref>: “Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition <3 (<5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-anakinsolo-pre.gif]], undated) prints it.
